gemm_nv_microtile.board: neural:gemm (4096^3), every NV identical-GEMM consumer (lm, cholesky/lu delayed update)
gemm_nv_microtile.note: Idea A1 (ideas-dense-linalg-20261011). NVIDIA IDENTICAL packed GEMM body (identical_gemm_kpack_kernel, GATHER): K window 16 -> 32 steps, two gather pairs a thread, A page pad 0 so two 128x64 blocks still fit a 100 KB SM. Halves per-FMA window overhead (barrier, window bounds, admission minima, staging). Execution plan only: same cells, same ascending p chain, same leaves and fold; no bit can move (NV digest must equal the off arm's and AMD's). AMD/Apple/host compile unchanged.
